titre: Devoir de synthèse n°3 - Anglais (9ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Ahmed had always dreamed of becoming a football player. However, when he was twelve, he had a serious accident and broke his leg. The doctors told him he might never play again. Ahmed was very sad, but he did not give up. He worked hard with a physiotherapist every day for a whole year. Slowly, his leg became stronger. Two years later, Ahmed joined his school team and scored the winning goal in an important match. His story shows that with courage and determination, we can overcome the most difficult obstacles.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (6 marks)
1) What was Ahmed's dream?   (1,5 marks)
2) What happened to him when he was twelve?   (1,5 marks)
3) How did Ahmed react to this difficult situation?   (1,5 marks)
4) What lesson does his story teach us?   (1,5 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put the verbs into the past simple: He (work) ______ hard and (join) ______ the team.   (2 marks)
2) Complete with the correct linker (but / so / because): He was sad, ______ he did not give up.   (1,5 marks)
3) Give the comparative of "strong": His leg became ______.   (1,5 marks)
4) Find in the text a word that means "difficulties / problems" = ______.   (1 mark)

III. WRITING (8 marks)
"Never give up on your dreams." Write a composition (about 12 lines) telling the story of a person (real or imaginary) who faced a difficulty but succeeded thanks to courage and hard work. Use the past simple and linkers.
